Four Studio services

What Studio builds.

4 items

  • 01Businesses and founders

    Custom Web Apps

    • Customer and vendor portals
    • Booking systems and marketplaces
    • Internal apps, SaaS and management platforms

    Why it's different · Scoped after a demand check, with a written 'won't build' list.

  • 02Customers, staff and field teams

    Mobile Apps

    • Customer, employee and owner apps
    • Driver, field, agent and technician apps
    • Offline-friendly where the job needs it

    Why it's different · Built with React Native on the same APIs as the web.

  • 03Companies with unique workflows

    Custom ERP Development

    • DigitalBurj core plus client-specific workflows
    • Industry integrations
    • Migration from spreadsheets and legacy tools

    Why it's different · We never rebuild common modules — you inherit them.

  • 04Anyone with disconnected tools

    API & System Integration

    • Payments and banking where supported
    • WhatsApp, email and accounting
    • e-Invoicing, Google/Meta and industry systems

    Why it's different · Official APIs, least-privilege access, full logs.

Standards

Production-ready means five things.

Working on a laptop isn't the bar. Every release is checked against the same list.

  • Correct — automated tests on every change
  • Secure — role-based access, scanned dependencies
  • Observable — errors and metrics dashboarded
  • Recoverable — backups restored on schedule
  • Maintainable — another engineer can run it
Read the checklist →

FAQ

Questions.

Custom software is appropriate when a defined workflow cannot be handled adequately by standard modules or existing tools. Start with discovery and scope the unique requirements before development.

Studio includes API and system integration work. Feasibility depends on the systems, available APIs, permissions and required data flows, which are assessed during discovery.

Custom development is scoped and quoted separately from shared platform subscriptions. Requirements, integrations and migration work determine the project scope.

Test the idea before you build it.
